name: The Gitrog Monster
oracle_text:
Deathtouch
At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice The Gitrog Monster unless you sacrifice a land.
You may play an additional land on each of your turns.
Whenever one or more land cards are put into your graveyard from anywhere, draw a card.
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more land cards are put into your graveyard from anywhere, draw a card.

needs.what: a trigger event that fires when a card matching a filter (here: a land card, owner = you) is put into a graveyard from ANY zone -- battlefield (sacrifice/destroy), hand (discard), library (mill, surveil), stack -- and supports `batched: true` so that several land cards moved by one event (a mill of three lands, a discard of two lands) trigger it exactly once ("one or more")
needs.why_existing_wont_do: leaves_battlefield with to_zones ["graveyard"] sees only permanents leaving the battlefield and misses discarded, milled and surveilled land cards, which are the card's whole engine (Gitrog + discard/dredge loops); discard covers only the hand and carries no card-type filter on the moved card from library; there is no mill or generic zone-change-to-graveyard event in trigger_events. Combining leaves_battlefield and discard triggers would still miss mill/surveil and would trigger twice for a single simultaneous event that moves lands from two zones. The draw half is a plain draw op once the event exists. The upkeep 'sacrifice unless you sacrifice a land' and extra_land_drops lines are expressible today.
